title: 65_HS1-834228961_62-HQ-83894_Serial_449
doc_notes: This document is a collection of FBI case file records and newspaper clippings regarding UFO sightings and the Amalgamated Flying Saucer Clubs of America (AFSCA) from 1965-1966.

incidents.summary: Johnny Sparks, 11, reported seeing two saucer-shaped objects with legs that landed in his driveway.
incidents.quote: The top part spun, but the ring part didn't. It was like a big fat doughnut.

incidents.summary: Two boys observed a hovering object with flashing lights over a swamp.
incidents.quote: The object hovered about 100 to 200 yards from the boys, from 150 feet to 300 feet above the ground.

incidents.summary: Louis S. Smith family observed a saucer-shaped object using binoculars and a telescope.
incidents.quote: It appeared to be traveling from north to south

incidents.summary: Charles Cozens reported touching the antenna of a glowing flying ship, resulting in a burn.
incidents.quote: A 13-year-old Hamilton boy has a curved burn on his hand he claims came from touching the antenna
incidents.shape: eight feet long, four feet wide

incidents.summary: Police Constable Donald Cameron observed six glowing objects from his home.
incidents.quote: One was bigger than the others with a cup-shaped dome—obviously the mothership

incidents.summary: Two police officers observed a flaming, copper-colored object on a highway.
incidents.quote: One of them, Koos de Klerk, said that the shiny copper-colored object resembled a giant spinning top.

incidents.summary: Gary T. Wilcox reported an encounter with an egg-shaped craft and its occupants.
incidents.quote: Mr. Wilcox touched the metallic, egg-shaped craft and heard its strange speech
